title: tasklist-doctor: INDEX integrity check command
description:
Architect-reviewer flagged ARCH-N: complement to TASK-028 resolver safety net. Add an orchestrator-side `tasklist-doctor` command (or scripts/tasklist-doctor.mjs) that scans .tasks/tasks/*.json shard files vs INDEX rows and reports drift:
- Shards in INDEX.open_tasks but with shard.status in DONE_STATUSES (would be caught by TASK-028's resolver safety net, but doctor surfaces it on-demand as a maintenance/CI check)
- Shards listed in INDEX but missing on disk (orphaned INDEX rows)
- Shard files on disk but missing from INDEX (un-rebuilt INDEX)
- Shards with malformed JSON or missing required fields

Report format: human-readable summary + JSON envelope for CI consumption. Exit codes: 0 = clean, 1 = drift detected, 2 = errors.

Not urgent — TASK-028 catches the runtime case. Doctor is for proactive auditing and CI gates.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/tasklist-doctor.mjs (or equivalent) exists and can be invoked via `node scripts/tasklist-doctor.mjs`
Detects all 4 drift cases listed above and reports them in human + JSON formats
Exit codes: 0 (clean), 1 (drift detected, no error), 2 (read/parse errors)
Unit + integration tests cover each drift case
lib/README.md or similar documents the command
